title: Shared lab books
intro: Share selected research as encrypted files with confirmed organization members. They can read their copy or edit it and return changes for your review. Each installation keeps its own workspace keys.
offline: Files are exchanged manually. Revoking access blocks future exports and accepted changes; it cannot erase copies already delivered.
contactHelp: Ask the confirmed member to download their sharing contact here. Observanda checks its signature against their enrolled identity.
editGrantHelp: Changing access invalidates previously prepared files. Prepare a new copy for the member after saving.
savedRefreshFailed: The change was saved, but the view could not refresh. Use Refresh shared research to reload it.
projectScope: Project access includes its subprojects and future lab books. You can also select individual lab books below.
working: This workspace is a shared copy
copyHelp: Create the shared copy in an empty folder, then open it through Workspaces. You can read and edit it using the ordinary lab-book tools. Structure and publishing settings are controlled by the owner.
created: Shared workspace created at {path}. Open it from Workspaces.
ready: Encrypted file prepared. Download it and send it to the intended recipient.
received: File authenticated. Review its lab books or returned changes below.
updateHelp: Review the owner's latest edition before updating this workspace. Keep your local version or accept the incoming version for each change. Applying this review also adopts the owner's lab-book structure and updates the shared base for your next return file.
structureHelp: These owner changes will be applied with the review. If a book is removed from the shared selection, records you keep remain in your local copy and are excluded from future returns.
absentBook: Not part of this shared edition.
alreadyCurrent: This edition is already included or has been superseded.
reviewHelp: Compare changes before accepting them. A conflict means your current research also changed since the shared copy. Existing publication choices stay under your control.
emptyReview: No changed records or evidence were found.
accepted: Review saved. Accepted changes are available in the lab books.
noOrganization: Create an organization or complete a member invitation above before sharing research.
scopeRequired: Choose at least one lab book.
invalidFile: Choose a valid sharing contact file.
workspaceChanged: The workspace changed. Reopen Shared lab books.
enrollmentFirst: Complete your organization invitation and import its confirmation before opening a shared copy.
